title: Tentative agreement for public health nurses
subtitle: Short special meeting following closed session; routine by-law confirmation and adjournment.
overview: Regional Council held a short special meeting on November 4, 2025, to consider a summary from its closed committee. Council reconvened in open session and approved the closed committee's recommendation {{vote:m2}}.

The recommendation approves a tentative Memorandum of Agreement for the Region's public health nursing staff, who are represented by ONA Local 15. It covers July 1, 2025, to June 30, 2028. For residents, this sets the terms of employment for the nurses who deliver regional public health services over the next three years.

Council also passed the by-law confirming the proceedings of the meeting {{vote:m4}} and adjourned shortly after. There were no presentations, no correspondence and no declarations of pecuniary interest. The minutes and transcript do not give details of the agreement's terms or cost.

decisions.detail: Council approved a tentative Memorandum of Agreement with ONA Local 15 for the Region's public health nursing staff, covering July 1, 2025, to June 30, 2028.

debate: No debate took place on the closed committee recommendation. The Regional Chair read it aloud, and it was moved, seconded and voted on.
The Chair noted the electronic voting system was slow to keep up with the pace of the vote, and Council waited for it to catch up before the result was confirmed.
